// Package unformatted holds shapes gofmt would rewrite, which the pattern looks through: doubled parentheses around
// the callee, the format and the argument, and a stray semicolon.
package unformatted

import "fmt"

type Number int

func (Number) String() string { return "" }

type Text string

func unformatted(text string, number Number, other Text, raw []byte) {
	_ = ((fmt.Sprintf))(("%s"), ((text)))
	_ = fmt.Sprintf((("%s")), ((number)))
	_ = fmt.Sprintf("%s", ((other)));
	_ = fmt.Sprintf("%s", ((raw)))
	_ = fmt.Sprintf("%s", ((*&number)))
	_ = ((fmt.Sprintf("%s", ((text + text)))))[0]
}
